narrative.overview: Warm ivory, graphite typography, an open outlined wordmark and hairline working divisions support security review. Shared typography links Veyra to Orbis.

rules.name: Evidence remains readable
rules.body: Use consistent light surfaces across every state, including dialogs and reports.

dos: Keep evidence and report copy intact.
Use cobalt to identify active state and key data.
donts: Do not imply autonomous agents or security certification.
Do not add external asset requests or weaken CSP.
